thread:
alex: Heads-up: quick readout for v5.0-int4 onboard. Baseline v4.9 fp16 vs v5.0 int4. Overall delta small, but we see consistent MRR regression on doc-thread slice. Need a concise canary rule before shifting traffic.

 rina: Numbers? sample sizes and CI?

 alex: control 12k, variant 3k. overall mrr -0.8% (ci lower -0.015). doc-thread (>=1500 tokens) mrr -5.6% (ci lower -0.047). latency ok.

 chao: Sounds like classic kv-merge edgecases in quant path. We should use bootstrap lower-bound comparator and per-slice mins.

 sam: Proposed minimal policy:
  - global_min: 1000 requests
  - per_slice_min: doc-thread 600
  - comparator: bootstrap 95% lower bound
  - abort_threshold: -0.03 rel for key metric (mrr)
  - sustained: 3 consecutive windows (window=1800s)
  - ensemble: require either (mrr + accept_rate) or (mrr + entropy_proxy) to cross
  - auto_rollback: enabled only if ensemble and ci lower <= threshold for sustained windows

 alex: Add hysteresis: if variant recovers above -1% lower bound within 2 windows, suppress rollback and route to human review. Also cooldown 6h post-rollback.

 rina: We should cap consecutive windows (max 5) to avoid infinite waiting on low-volume slices and use a minimum effect size (0.01) to filter tiny diffs.

 chao: For quick triage, deploy-bot should dump top 200 regression pairs to artifacts and run the evaluator diff. Also flag for prompt-truncation patterns.

 deploy-bot: [system] I can run dry-canary, post artifacts to /artifacts/canary/2141592653 and create policy draft "int4-ensemble-anchored-v1". Schedule?

 alex: Schedule dry-canary 2023-11-10T09:00Z. Action items: rina to update policy PR with minima+hysteresis, chao to run top-200 diffs and annotate prompt truncation, sam to wire Optimize bootstrap endpoint into canary checker, deploy-bot to run dry-canary and post artifacts.

 rina: Ill also add a short smoke check: run N=500 paired evals for long-doc subset before allowing any traffic split >5%.

 chao: +1. I'll look at token-level alignments for the top 50 regressions and post notes.

 alex: Thanks. Keep promotion locked until policy and smoke checks are green.

 sam: One more: add an entropy/length quick-proxy auto-flag: if entropy drops >25% and mrr down >2% trigger immediate hold and human review.

 deploy-bot: [system] Dry-canary scheduled. Policy draft created.
